craft_notes: Sthāyin: parokṣa-dīkṣā unit 26. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 16. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: By this to-be-covered goes dependence on another; facing-towards-ness at first; is led to five, if all — then from the middle of the path as desired, in drawing and extracting, or in the matter of the dead person to be drawn — then in the living, yoga called the net, taught in the Śrī-Śaṃbhunātha-āgama, spoken by me.
l4.sanskrit_cite: etenācchādanīyaṃ vrajati paravaśaṃ saṃmukhīnatvamādau pañcādānīyate cetsakalamatha tato@pyadhvamadhyādyatheṣṭam ākṛṣṭāvuddhṛtau vā mṛtajanaviṣaye karṣaṇīye@tha jīve yogaḥ śrīśaṃbhunāthāgamaparigamito jālanāmā mayoktaḥ
